# Ultragentic

> Everything you need in the agentic era: the spec-to-PR agent harness for AI coding agents. Agent skills (SKILL.md), slash commands, hooks, and a Go
> runtime that take Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, opencode, Google Antigravity, Kimi Code, or Muse
> from a one-line goal to a reviewed pull request, advancing only on recorded evidence (tests, lint,
> CI, review). Install once per machine, or mount into any repo as a git submodule.

Use it when you want the same spec-driven development workflow (`/spec`, `/plan`, `/build`, `/test`,
`/review`, `/ship`, `/goal`, `/auto`) and the same guardrails across several coding agents, instead
of maintaining separate rules and prompts for each one.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/README.md): install (global or per-repo), supported hosts, the three ways to work
- [Command router](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/.ai-agents/commands/ROUTER.md): every slash command and when to use it
- [Asset router](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/.ai-agents/ROUTER.md): skills, agents, and references by task

## Workflow

- [/goal](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/.ai-agents/commands/goal.md): one objective to a merged pull request, with human approval gates
- [/auto](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/.ai-agents/commands/auto.md): the same graph with gates answered by CI and file evidence
- [Delivery graph](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/.ai-agents/graphs/goal-delivery.yaml): the spec → plan → build → test → review → ship nodes

## Policy and authoring

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the shared behavioral baseline loaded every turn
- [Permissions](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/.ai-agents/PERMISSIONS.md): permission policy per host
- [Authoring guide](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/.ai-agents/AUTHORING.md): writing skills and commands, mounting into a consumer repo

## Optional

- [Runtime](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/runtime/README.md): the `ultragentic` Go binary, flags, and web UI
- [Host hook contracts](https://github.com/ducnd58233/ultragentic/blob/main/.ai-agents/references/host-hook-contracts.md): hook events per coding host
